promoter-desc: Edit campaigns and advertisements for use by other extensions
promoter-summary:
This module allows you to edit the currently defined campaigns.
It can also be used to add and remove old campaigns.
promoter-no-campaigns-exist:
No campaigns exist yet.
Add one below.
promoter-null-string:
Cannot add an empty string.
Add will not be performed.
promoter-campaign-exists:
Campaign already exists.
Add will not be performed.
promoter-archive-edit-prevented: Editing this campaign is disabled because it is locked or archived. Please change this status via [[Special:Promoter]].
promoter-no-ads-assigned:
No ads are assigned to this campaign.
Add some!
promoter-balanced: Give equal weight to all ads
promoter-ad-already-linked:
Ad is already linked to a campaign.
Add will not be performed.
promoter-ad-inconsistent-dates-error: You must set both a display start date and a display end date, or leave both fields empty
promoter-ad-date-end-bigger-than-date-st: The display end date must be later than the display start date
promoter-ad-linked-campaigns-empty: No linked campaigns. This ad is orphaned.
promoter-edit-ad-summary: To create a translatable message, wrap strings in triple curly braces with dashes, e.g. {{{jimbo-quote}}}.
promoter-ad-name-error: Invalid ad name. Valid names contain only letters, numbers, and underscores.
promoter-ad-still-bound:
Cannot remove ad "$1" because it is still linked to a campaign.
Removal will not be performed.
